identification: Two silver full-hunter pocket watches: one with a white enamel Roman dial, subsidiary seconds and gilt hands, engine-turned back with a vacant cartouche; the other with a white enamel Roman dial missing all its hands and damaged at the seconds dial, plain back with a small cartouche. Inside the covers are small hallmark-type punches, a sponsor's mark in a rectangle and case numbers, none legible in the photos.

viewing_check: One watch has no hands and damage at the seconds dial, so treat it as parts. Check that both movements are present and complete, whether either runs with a key, and read the case marks (lion passant and date letter for sterling). The AU$392.90 Rotherhams sale already on file (137794882143) was a Best Offer accepted listing, so that figure is eBay's original asking price, not necessarily the price paid.
